sources.entry: Citadel - Groupware including email, calendar/scheduling, address books, forums, mailing lists, IM, wiki and blog engines, RSS aggregation and more. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 C/Docker/Shell

summary.name: Citadel
summary.one_liner: Citadel is a 100% open source, GPL-licensed groupware and collaboration system combining email, calendaring, contacts, forums, mailing lists, instant messaging, wiki, blog, and RSS aggregation.
use_cases: self-hosting email and calendar for a team
hosting a wiki or blog on own server
syncing calendars and contacts via CalDAV and CardDAV
summary.what_it_does: Citadel provides email, calendar and contacts (with CalDAV and CardDAV support), forums, mailing lists, and instant messaging in one system. It also includes wiki, blog, and RSS aggregation features. Its organization is based on "rooms," which the site presents as a consistent metaphor for combining these features. It supports multiple domains and offers a web interface, and the server is written in C. The page says it can be installed on your own hardware or in the cloud, and it lists a Docker deployment option.
notable: Rooms-based architecture combining email, forums, wiki, and chat under one metaphor
CalDAV and CardDAV support for calendars and contacts
Written in C, GPL-3.0 licensed with no paid enterprise edition
Multi-domain support with a web interface
caveats: Page does not list specific supported operating systems beyond Docker and web; Linux is inferred only from the listing's general context and is not stated on the page
